## Description

[//]: # "Summarize the change, why it's needed, and link the issue it closes (e.g. Closes #12)."

## Type of Change

[//]: # "Please select one"

- [ ] Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Bugfix (`fix`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Plugin updates, CI, or tooling (`chore`, `ci`, `build`)
- [ ] Other (`perf`, `style`, `test`, `revert`)

## Checklist

[//]: # "Please check all that apply"

- [ ] Starts without errors or warnings (`nvim --headless '+lua print("CONFIG_OK")' +qa`)
- [ ] Manually tested the affected keymaps, filetypes, or plugins in `nvim`
- [ ] Checked on Windows and Linux, or the change is platform-independent
- [ ] Formatted with StyLua and no selene warnings (`stylua --check .`, `selene .`)
- [ ] `lazy-lock.json` changes are intentional plugin updates
- [ ] `README.md`, `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, or `AGENTS.md` updated if requirements, keymaps, or structure changed
